grammar.summary: 本课学习表否定的双重结构与审讯问答时态。

points.title: 双重否定 not...un-
points.explanation: not uncommon = 相当常见。本课 alibi 审讯对话里 did not catch the train / had never been to the station 过去时态链。

examples.en: He claimed that he had been at the station.

points.title: 表依据的 judging by
points.explanation: Judging by his clothes, ... = 从……判断，独立分词结构，悬垂分词的特例（不依附主语）。

examples.en: He spoke in a very convincing way.
